minimal_generalizable_rule: All evidence must refer to the same city and a fixed target alert episode.
The source chronology and wording must support one compatible attack/event sequence.
At least one source must contain qualifying exact-city explosion/impact evidence.
At least one source must contain aerial-war context linked to that attack sequence.
At least one source must provide episode-specific temporal proof: an explicit event clock, an unambiguous explicit alert relation, or trusted contemporaneous live wording.
Previous and next alert episodes must be checked for contradiction or plausible reassignment.
Publication time may test chronology compatibility but must never be treated as event time.
Generic daily context, cumulative updates, and semantically duplicate syndication cannot transfer evidence between distinct attacks.
